said: The Reserve Bank of Australia's real responses, recorded by meridian-rba's authors on 2026-11-19: its statistical tables F1 (money market, 4 January 2011 to 19 November 2026), F2 (government bond yields, daily, 20 May 2013 to 11 November 2026), F17 (zero-coupon yields, 3 January 2017 to 30 October 2026) and F11.1 (exchange rates, daily, 3 January 2023 to 19 November 2026), each CSV as received, gzipped. The RBA's statistical data are under its own terms; F1's BABs/NCDs columns are ASX's, its OIS columns FENICS's, and F11.1's A$1=USD WM/Reuters', third-party material whose use needs the third party's consent (https://www.rba.gov.au/copyright/). Sample data answers each request from them, and the tests read them.
